audit.why: This is a fabricated mechanic per the kit authority (enemyKit R flags) and Riot's own ability text; it would ship a wrong claim about dodging CC.
audit.corrected: Replaced 'untargetable/unstoppable' language with 'move speed lets him dive' in whys[4], spikes[1].text, and content.mid.

edits.before: Through 3-6 he keeps the initiative. His E charm bounces between you and your ADC, and once R comes online he becomes untargetable to dive your position. Your only counter is a reactive Encore root, but it's easily juked mid-dash, so treat every trade as him choosing the terms.
